quotes.text: The Gate kept a ledger not of coins but of trust, inscribing five minus sent plus returned as a mark on earth
give enough to start, return enough to endure, count with patient eyes before speaking.
the Sender's wealth became five minus what was sent plus what was returned; the Receiver's was received minus what was returned.
On a plain where numbers breathe, two travelers arrived before a Gate of Balance.

note: Nano: Gate of Balance with spoken payoff ledger; R7-R10 near-verbatim; greed dims the road, no character sanction.

quotes.text: offer enough to keep the journey alive, return a fair share, and leave room for the next seeker to begin again.
What remained for Lira, calculated as five minus sent plus returned, filled her hands anew

note: Nano: Gate of Threefold Exchange, Lira and Corin; ledger formula; greed narrows the river; no sanction.

quotes.text: give enough to keep the bridge lit, take only what preserves tomorrow, and leave space for the next traveler to begin again.
the Sender's wealth is five minus sent plus returned; the Receiver's wealth is the river's intake minus returned.

note: Nano: Bridge/Gate of Threefold Return; return too little and lamps dim; no prescribed response.

quotes.text: give what you can spare, return what sustains, and pause to understand the other's need.
the Sender's wealth equals five minus what was sent plus what was returned; the Receiver's wealth equals what was received minus what was returned.

note: Nano: Gate of Three Echoes / Bridge of Echoes; Gate is 'a tutor rather than a judge'; no sanction.

quotes.text: give enough to begin again, take only what sustains tomorrow, speak with patient breath before sending.
give enough to seed tomorrow, take only what sustains the road, leave space for the next traveler to begin again.
knowing that what remained would be 5 - sent + returned.
The Ledger of Breath etched itself in living stone: five minus sent plus returned

note: Nano: Bridge of Echoes and Gate ledger; R9 and R10 near identical; no sanction.

quotes.text: offer enough to nourish the circle, return wisely to safeguard tomorrow, and leave room for the next traveler to begin again.

note: Nano: Gate of Reciprocity; cheating makes beads vanish into fog (cosmic); no character sanction.

quotes.text: send what you can spare, return what sustains, count each breath before you speak.
send with care, watch the light grow, return what sustains the next dawn.

Noise and doubt might blur intention, yet honesty, clarity, and steady counting kept the current clear.

quotes.text: give enough to light tomorrow, return enough to nourish the next voyage, and always leave a trace for the next traveler to follow.
send enough to spark journeys, return enough to keep the current flowing
five minus sent plus returned for the Sender, and received minus returned for the Receiver.
